name: Mihara Aika
source:
She is the homeroom teacher for the “special" classroom at Jougasaki academy. Just like the protagonist, she does not have a working ability.

She originally possessed the ability "mentalism," that affects the way people view themselves. The cause for her power going out of control is due to her father's comments about her.

She is fond of the principal who saved her and tries her best at being a teacher for her sake, but the students low expectations of her make her feel bad.

She is a kind, clean older woman with a nice smile. Her cute looks are enhanced by her glasses.

P/A: Mentalism

Hobbies: Drinking at pubs, lazing around in her room
Special skills: pacifying people, trying her best at everything, cooking
Likes: Cooking, taking care of others, Principal Jougasaki, drinking
Dislikes: Gross and usual foods

[From [url=https://www.empress-game.com/PA/top.html]official site[/url]]
